instructions.name: CreateMetadataAccountV3
expected_state_changes: creates a metadata account at PDA ['metadata', program_id, mint]
records name, symbol, uri from instruction data
risk_rules: metadata PDA must derive from ['metadata', program_id, mint]
RISK: metadata for an attacker-controlled mint can carry phishing URI — flag unknown mints

instructions.name: UpdateMetadataAccountV2
risk_rules: update_authority must be signer — only current authority may update
RISK: URI swap to phishing content is invisible to the chain — flag high-value metadata updates
RISK: authority transfer to attacker — flag PermissionEscalation

instructions.name: SignMetadata
expected_state_changes: marks the creator as verified on the metadata
risk_rules: creator must be a declared creator on the metadata
RISK: creator verification is reputation-bearing — flag unverified-creator signatures

instructions.name: VerifyCollection
expected_state_changes: verifies the NFT belongs to the collection
risk_rules: collection_authority must be the verified delegate
RISK: fake collection verification — flag if collection PDA mismatches declared authority

instructions.name: BurnNft
expected_state_changes: burns the NFT token and closes the metadata
risk_rules: owner must be signer and own the token_account
token_account must be owned by accounts.owner
RISK: burning someone else's NFT via authority confusion — flag if owner ≠ token account owner

verification.program_id_source: https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com getAccountInfo executable=true 2026-08-07 + official mpl-token-metadata repo
verification.discriminators_source: C24 re-verification (2026-08-09): program is Shank-derived, NOT Anchor — u8 discriminators from the enum order in mpl-token-metadata program/src/instruction/mod.rs
verification.notes: CORRECTED 2026-08-09: the previous 8-byte values (0fd902b83e0f4ee4, 1ec413bd20e86291, ...) were NEVER observed on-chain — the old verification note claiming live observation was fabricated (same artifact class as C22.4/DCA). The deployed program (metaqbxx...) is Shank-derived with u8 instruction discriminators: on-chain census (base58-correct) observed data starting 0x21 (=33, CreateMetadataAccountV3) and 0x0f (=15, UpdateMetadataAccountV2). Per the Shank enum order: SignMetadata=7 (0x07), VerifyCollection=18 (0x12), BurnNft=29 (0x1d), CreateMetadataAccountV3=33 (0x21), UpdateMetadataAccountV2=15 (0x0f). Discriminators are 1-byte hex; find_instruction matches by prefix so real '21...' data resolves.
